import Foundation.HigherHeatCubicIto

open HigherHeatCubicIto HigherHeatDyadicTimeDensity HigherHeatContinuousDualCoordinate

noncomputable def reconstructed (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) : Dual :=
  (3:ℕ) • HigherHeatAdaptedIntegralClosure.integral 2 (by norm_num) T hT (quadraticInput T hT) +
  (3:ℕ) • secondChannel 2 T (curveField 2 (by norm_num) T hT) +
  thirdChannel T (constantField 2 (by norm_num) T hT)

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) : quadraticCurve T hT zeroTime = 0 := by
  change quadraticCurve T hT (node 0 (prefixNode 0 0 (Nat.zero_le _))) = 0
  rw [quadratic_curve_prefix, HigherHeatQuadraticItoData.prefix_zero,
    zero_pow (by decide : (2:ℕ) ≠ 0), map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    quadraticCurve T hT ⟨1,zero_le_one,le_rfl⟩ =
      pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^2)) := by
  have ht : node 0 (prefixNode 0 (size 0) le_rfl) = ⟨1,zero_le_one,le_rfl⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [prefix_time]
    norm_num [size,HigherHeatDyadicLaws.gridSize,HigherHeatDyadicLaws.duration]
  rw [← ht, quadratic_curve_prefix, HigherHeatQuadraticItoData.prefix_end, map_pow]
  rfl

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    reconstructed T hT (core terminalCylinder) = -24*(T:ℝ) := by
  unfold reconstructed
  rw [← cubic_ito T hT, witness_pairing]
  norm_num

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    reconstructed T hT (core (terminalCylinder^5)) = 20160*(T:ℝ)^2 := by
  unfold reconstructed
  rw [← cubic_ito T hT, pairing_core_real, ← pow_add, terminal_moments]
  have hm := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by norm_num) (-(T:ℝ)) 2
  norm_num [neg_pow] at hm ⊢
  nlinarith [hm]

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    reconstructed T hT (core (terminalCylinder^9)) = -79833600*(T:ℝ)^3 := by
  unfold reconstructed
  rw [← cubic_ito T hT, pairing_core_real, ← pow_add, terminal_moments]
  have hm := PseudoPolynomialStein.moment_multiple 4 (by norm_num) (-(T:ℝ)) 3
  norm_num [neg_pow] at hm ⊢

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^3)) -
      HigherHeatCompletedSignedMean.mean 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^3)) •
        pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (1:Cylinder)) = reconstructed T hT := by
  rw [witness_centered, zero_smul]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro G
  change pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^3)) G - 0 = reconstructed T hT G
  unfold reconstructed
  simpa only [_root_.sub_zero] using congrArg (fun φ : Dual => φ G) (cubic_ito T hT)
